prompt: A forgotten corner of a human garden, now an ant ruin: a giant cracked white porcelain teacup lies on its side, half sunk into dark moss, forming a domed hall; its broken rim and faded blue painted flowers are overgrown with glowing teal fungi and hanging moss. Around it an old rusted iron key as long as a bridge spans a narrow earthen gully, old copper coins are stacked like tilted terraces green with verdigris, a lost four-hole shirt button lies like a round plaza, and a bent sewing needle leans like a fallen spire. Ant trails run between these relics. Painterly concept art in soft gouache and watercolour with visible brush texture, cinematic composition. Ant's-eye macro view from ground level: everything is seen as a one-centimetre ant would see it, with a shallow depth of field. Deep night: cool blue-teal darkness lit mainly by bioluminescent fungi and a few warm amber glows, light mist and drifting spores. Mysterious, calm and beautiful. A few tiny ants walking on a trail show the scale. Wide 16:9 landscape image. No text, no people, no frame, no border.
